entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: He sure does look like a bad guy.[n]Not really final boss material, though.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Hmm? I think I see somebody in[n]the glass...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Nope! Hold it! Kids don't need to[n]get any closer than that!

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: So this is Mr. Kamoshida's twisted[n]heart?

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: I had no idea...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Well, this is just a representation of[n]his heart. You probably wouldn't see[n]anything so strange in the real world.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: But, the fact that there are people out[n]there carrying demons in their hearts[n]like this...

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Wh-What is this? Is this... Kamoshida!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Treating students like they're his[n]damn slaves... Just rememberin' it[n]PISSES me off!

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Heheh, he really did treat us like crap,[n]didn't he?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: So this is the Shadow form of the[n]Phantom Thieves' first target? He's[n]even more disgusting than I expected.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: He nearly ruined your lives, right? You[n]should have gotten even and taken[n]everything from him... including his life.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...I just thought death would be too good[n]for him. That's all.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Is this Mr— I mean, is this Kamoshida?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: His appearance is awfully warped,[n]but it does indeed seem to be him.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: He really is a monster...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: When I think about what he was doing[n]to the students, I can't help but feel[n]responsible in some way...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Wh-What is this?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Yeah, I don't know anything about[n]his aura, or his fate in the cards,[n]or whatever...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: But I can tell right now—that guy's not[n]right in the head.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Everything about him is distorted.[n]I'm almost afraid to read any further[n]into it...

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: So this was the first target of the Phantom[n]Thieves...

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: If memory serves me correctly, they[n]began gaining power around that time.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Quite the pleasant surprise, considering[n]what we expected of them originally.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: That just goes to show you how effective[n]our rehabilitation truly is!

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: *chuckle*

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Your talent for hiding your true feelings[n]is keen as ever, Caroline.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Wh-What!? What do you mean by that!?

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: ...S-Stop giving me that look, Justine!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Hey, is that who I think it is in the glass[n]there?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: C-Cut it out, Futaba! We shouldn't[n]mention that to her...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Uh— Ohhhhh! Don't worry, Ann![n]I couldn't see anything I haven't[n]already!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Thanks, guys... Your concern is[n]killing me...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: So this was the Shadow born from[n]Kamoshida's twisted desires...[n]Who would've thought, huh?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: He even treated Mishima-kun and[n]Shiho like slaves in his Palace...[n]What an absolute scumbag.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You're damn right. I still get chills if[n]I think about what woulda happened[n]if we lost to him.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: A teacher feeding off his students...[n]What a wholly rotten mind.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: He put me in a swimsuit and treated me[n]like his princess all over his Palace...[n]What a nightmare.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Like a princess? Knowing you as I do[n]now, I can only assume he was quite[n]the eccentric.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You got that right!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...Wait, was that an insult?
